prompts.dog: Create a NEW transparent torso sprite, do NOT reproduce the torso shape in this reference atlas. Reference is ONLY for golden puppy fur color and painterly texture. Render ONE isolated anatomically natural right-facing puppy trunk ONLY, without head, neck stump, tail, limbs or paws. Existing legs will be attached in code. The new silhouette must be MUCH SHALLOWER than the reference: opaque body width approximately 2.7 times its height. A single coherent ribcage tapering gently into the waist and rounded rear pelvis, almost level gently convex back, one flowing mildly tucked belly line. Crucial anatomy correction: NO large downward circular rump, NO separate visible round thigh/haunch patch, NO deep dangling front chest lobe. Hip and shoulder stay INSIDE this single shallow torso, not bulges hanging below. Rump on LEFT, chest on RIGHT. The belly on left and right should descend only a little below the middle belly; it must not look like a dumbbell or two joined balls. No pointed spike on the back or shoulder. Continuous short pale golden fur flowing through the whole body, warm cream-gold highlights, matching the reference puppy's leg fur, children's picture-book soft realistic brushwork. Ribcage and belly smoothly shaded with no outlined muscle circles or inset pieces. Completely transparent surrounding alpha. One large centered body component with margins. No other parts, no atlas, no animal head, no text, no diagrams, no guides, no floor, no shadow.
